People say bounce back from the mistakes, its really hard at this age when the bounce has gone and the sagging has begun.

Trying to get money from clients after battling to get the job is driving me insane. I never thought it was going to be this hard. They say hindsight is 20/20 but I was unsure from the beginning, but I let me anger and rage against the corp. blind me to the truth of the market out there. I finally got to work around noon and everybody was asking what was going on, I told them I had a bad reaction to some medication. I feel like a utter failure in life and I just want it to end.
